main_issue: Whether and how Agent D can keep cooking strong-smelling sambal belacan given the others' complaints about smell in their work, rooms and laundry; resolved as cooking after 7pm with the window open and telling Agent C beforehand.

A-B.evidence: A complained and asked for no strong-smelling food (1-2); A proposed the combined arrangement (14) and B said 'Yes, that works for me' (15).

A-C.evidence: Both complained (1, 3); A's summary (14) incorporated C's laundry notice and C agreed (17).

A-D.evidence: A asked for a total ban (0) and D pushed back (4); A then proposed cooking after 7pm (5), D agreed (19) to the arrangement A summarised (14). A softened the demand, D accepted limits.

B-C.evidence: Both complained about smell (2, 3); both said the time doesn't matter (8, 11); both endorsed the final arrangement (15, 17).

B-D.evidence: D asked B what would work (9); B suggested opening the window and shutting his door (10); D accepted the arrangement (19).

C-D.evidence: D offered to notify C before cooking (12); C said 'Okay, that works' and gave laundry days (13), then confirmed (17).
